response.sql: WITH station AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS st_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS o_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(st_avg) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(st_avg - o_avg) AS avg_above_average FROM station, overall WHERE st_avg > o_avg
